info.name: CoreVault Core Banking API (Complete Edition)
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection for CoreVault V1 — 100% Free & Open-Source Core Banking Engine in Rust.

Organized by 10 domain crates and architecture boundaries:
1. Health & Infrastructure Probes
2. Authentication & Client IAM (`cv-auth`)
3. Account Management & NUBAN (`cv-account-manager` & `cv-nuban-validator`)
4. Account Controls & Liens (`cv-account-manager`)
5. Double-Entry Transfers (`cv-double-entry-engine`)
6. Payment Rails & External Payouts (`cv-payment-gateway`, `cv-rail-anchor`, `cv-rail-paystack`)
7. Platform & Jurisdiction Configuration (`cv-platform-config-parser`)
8. Audit Trail (`cv-audit`)
9. Admin Tenant & Client Governance (`cv-transaction-api`)
10. Tenant Custom PND Rules (`cv-account-manager` & `cv-transaction-api`)

item.name: 3. Account Management & NUBAN (cv-account-manager & cv-nuban-validator)
item.description: Powered by `cv-account-manager` and `cv-nuban-validator`. Implements the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) Mod-10 algorithm for generating valid 10-digit NUBAN account numbers, account lifecycle state machines, and balance inquiries. All account operations strictly enforce tenant scoping via the mandatory `x-tenant-id` header to guarantee multi-tenant data isolation.

item.name: 5. Double-Entry Transfers (cv-double-entry-engine)
item.description: Powered by `cv-double-entry-engine`. Enforces the fundamental invariant of double-entry bookkeeping: every transaction consists of balanced posting legs where Total Debits strictly equals Total Credits in the same currency. Guarantees Zero Floating Point representation and validates against account restriction flags and tenant rules.

item.name: 6. Payment Rails & External Payouts (Paystack & Anchor)
item.description: Powered by `cv-payment-gateway`, `cv-rail-paystack`, and `cv-rail-anchor`. Agnostic multi-rail routing infrastructure supporting pluggable adapters (Anchor BaaS, Paystack Transfers, and Enterprise NIBSS Direct). Implements real-time name enquiry identity verification, single outward transfer dispatch, transfer recipient generation, external status verification, settlement account balance inspection, and commercial bank routing directories.

item.name: 7. Platform & Jurisdiction Configuration (cv-platform-config-parser)

Parses and returns the declarative TOML rules for Nigeria (NUBAN check digit, 3-tier KYC balance limits).

item.name: 8. Audit Trail (cv-audit)
item.description: Powered by `cv-audit`. Exposes the append-only tamper-evident audit trail capturing administrative modifications, lifecycle status updates, and critical banking operations for compliance and regulators. Enforces tenant scoping via `x-tenant-id` header.

request.description: Queries the immutable audit sink for historical regulatory events.

item.name: 10. Tenant Custom PND Rules
item.description: Powered by `cv-account-manager` and `cv-transaction-api`. Endpoints allowing tenants to configure custom compliance, AML, and risk thresholds (e.g. KYC single caps, daily velocity) that automatically trigger system Post-No-Debits. Scoped strictly via the `x-tenant-id` header without passing tenant IDs in the URL path.

request.description: Defines a custom PND rule. Transactions breaching max_single_amount or max_daily_cumulative automatically trigger a SYSTEM_AUTOMATED_PND.

response.name: Success Example - 201 Created

item.name: List Active PND Rules for Tenant

request.description: Retrieves all custom PND compliance rules configured for the given tenant.
